tools.name: smartemailing_account_info
tools.description: Return basic information about the SmartEmailing account these credentials belong to. Good first call to confirm the connection. API: GET /account-info.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_contact_lists
tools.description: List contact lists (audiences) in the account with their names and settings. API: GET /contactlists.

tools.name: smartemailing_get_contact_list
tools.description: Return one contact list by its ID. API: GET /contactlists/{id}.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_contacts_in_list
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to one contact list. API: GET /contactlists/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: smartemailing_create_contact_list
tools.description: Create a new contact list with the given name. Creates a record in the account: it does not send any e-mail. API: POST /contactlists.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts across the account, with optional filters on e-mail, name, company, country and blacklist status. API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: smartemailing_get_contact
tools.description: Return one contact by its e-mail address (or numeric contact ID). Set expand_customfields to include custom field values. API: GET /contacts/{emailaddress}.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom contact fields defined in the account. API: GET /customfields.

tools.name: smartemailing_get_custom_field
tools.description: Return one custom contact field by its ID. API: GET /customfields/{id}.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_emails
tools.description: List e-mail campaigns (email templates) in the account. The vendor caps the page size. API: GET /emails.

tools.name: smartemailing_get_email
tools.description: Return one e-mail by its ID, including its HTML and text bodies when selected. API: GET /emails/{id}.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_newsletters
tools.description: List newsletters (sent campaigns) with their settings. API: GET /newsletter.

tools.name: smartemailing_get_email_performance
tools.description: Return delivery, open and click totals for sent e-mails, optionally grouped by time, domain or engagement level. API: GET /email-performance-overview.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_automations
tools.description: List marketing automations with their names and activation dates. API: GET /automations.

tools.name: smartemailing_get_automation
tools.description: Return one automation by its ID. API: GET /automations/{id}.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhooks that send account events to an external URL. API: GET /web-hooks.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_web_forms
tools.description: List the sign-up web forms in the account. API: GET /web-forms.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "smartemailing_account_info" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return basic information about the SmartEmailing account these credentials belong to. Good first call to confirm the connection. API: GET /account-info.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smartemailing_create_contact_list, smartemailing_list_emails, smartemailing_get_email, smartemailing_get_email_performance, smartemailing_list_webhooks · Private data: smartemailing_account_info, smartemailing_list_contact_lists, smartemailing_get_contact_list, smartemailing_list_contacts_in_list, smartemailing_create_contact_list, smartemailing_list_contacts, smartemailing_get_contact, smartemailing_list_custom_fields, smartemailing_get_custom_field · Public sink: smartemailing_create_contact_list, smartemailing_list_emails, smartemailing_get_email, smartemailing_get_email_performance, smartemailing_list_webhooks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smartemailing_create_contact_list, smartemailing_list_emails, smartemailing_get_email, smartemailing_get_email_performance, smartemailing_list_webhooks · Private data: smartemailing_account_info, smartemailing_list_contact_lists, smartemailing_get_contact_list, smartemailing_list_contacts_in_list, smartemailing_create_contact_list, smartemailing_list_contacts, smartemailing_get_contact, smartemailing_list_custom_fields, smartemailing_get_custom_field · Public sink: smartemailing_create_contact_list, smartemailing_list_emails, smartemailing_get_email, smartemailing_get_email_performance, smartemailing_list_webhooks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
